before.exam_tip_html: The 12-mark Evaluate question will often invite you to compare perspectives. The most common error is to describe all four perspectives without evaluating them — this caps you in the Developing tier. To reach Secure or Mastering, you must: compare (“Unlike functionalists, who argue…, Marxists contend…”), evaluate (“A limitation of the functionalist view is that it ignores…”), and judge (“On balance, the feminist perspective is more convincing because…”). Never describe all four perspectives as equally valid without explaining why you find one more or less convincing than another. The examiner is looking for a reasoned judgement, not a balanced description.
